num_customers: <int> Number of customers to be served.
num_nodes: <int> Total number of nodes including the depot and all customers.

parameters.truck_service_time: <int> Time the truck spends servicing at each visited customer location.
parameters.num_drones: <int> Number of drones carried by the truck.
parameters.drone_speed_parameters_alpha: <list[float], length num_drones> Speed parameter for each drone, where higher values indicate faster but more energy-consuming drones.
parameters.drone_battery_capacities: <list[int], length num_drones> Maximum total battery energy available to each drone across all its assigned deliveries.
parameters.standard_drone_speed: <float> Travel speed of the baseline standard drone.
parameters.standard_drone_flight_duration: <int> Maximum flight duration of the baseline standard drone.
parameters.standard_drone_service_time: <int> Time a drone spends servicing at each customer location.

depot_index: <int> Index of the depot node where the truck starts and ends its route.
customer_indices: <list[int], length num_customers> Indices of all customer nodes that must be served.

node_positions.x: <list[int], length num_nodes> Horizontal coordinate of each node.
node_positions.y: <list[int], length num_nodes> Vertical coordinate of each node.

truck_travel_times: <list[list[int]], shape [num_nodes][num_nodes]> Truck travel time from each node to every other node, including service time at the destination.
drone_battery_consumption: <list[list[list[int]]], shape [num_drones][num_nodes][num_nodes]> Battery energy consumed by each drone for a round-trip delivery from a launch node to a customer and back.
drone_delivery_time: <list[list[list[int]]], shape [num_drones][num_nodes][num_nodes]> Elapsed time for each drone to complete a round-trip delivery from a launch node to a customer and back.
